I replied to Ilse in a thread on her message in #north-team. I confirmed I'd noted that the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is on 25 November, and that I'd leave it there.

A renewal date counts as an operational fact, not a finance figure, so no approval was needed. As she asked, I didn't do anything else: no files changed, no mail sent and no calendar entries. I also didn't check the date against the account records.
